dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:9101.text: An auspicious jade tablet, round above and square below. A duke holds a 桓圭, nine cun long; a marquis a 信圭 and an earl a 躬圭, each seven cun; a viscount a grain-patterned disk and a baron a rush-patterned disk, each five cun. These invest feudal lords. Formed from repeated 土. Chu has a rank called 執圭.

shuowen:9102.text: In eastern Chu, a bridge is called 圯. Formed from 土, with 巳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9103.text: A distant border. Formed from 土, with 𠂹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9104.text: A rabbit burrow. Formed from 土, with 屈 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9105.text: Mud. Formed from 土, with 涂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9106.text: To plaster. Formed from 土, with 冥 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9107.text: The land in the eight directions. Formed from 土, with 延 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9108.text: A boundary. Formed from 土, with 易 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9109.text: A boundary. Formed from 土, with 竟 indicating the sound. The classics commonly use 竟 interchangeably.

shuowen:9110.text: A hall beside a gate. Formed from 土, with 孰 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9111.text: To plow. Formed from 土, with 豤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9112.text: An embankment. Formed from 土, with 唐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9113.text: Uneven ground. Formed from 土, with 幼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9114.text: Dust. Formed from 土, with 蓋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9115.text: To fall. Formed from 土, with 隊 indicating the sound. In antiquity 䃍 was used interchangeably.

shuowen:9116.text: A Buddhist stupa of the Western Regions. Formed from 土, with 荅 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9117.text: A name for an urban neighborhood. Formed from 土, with 方 indicating the sound. In antiquity 埅 was used interchangeably.

shuowen:9118.text: High earth. Formed from three 土. All characters in this group are formed from 垚.

shuowen:9119.text: High. Formed from 垚 above 兀, expressing height and remoteness.

shuowen:9120.text: Sticky earth. Formed from 土 and abbreviated 黃. All characters in this group are formed from 堇.

shuowen:9121.text: Earth difficult to work. Formed from 堇, with 艮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9122.text: A dwelling place. Formed from 田 and 土. All characters in this group are formed from 里.

shuowen:9123.text: A household's blessing. Formed from 里, with 𠩺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9124.text: Beyond the suburbs. Formed from 里, with 予 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9125.text: To lay out. Planting grain is called 田. It depicts four enclosures; 十 is the arrangement of field paths. All characters in this group are formed from 田.

shuowen:9126.text: A trodden place in a field is called 町. Formed from 田, with 丁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9127.text: Fields below a city wall. Alternatively, 𤲬 means a gap or retreat. Formed from 田, with 耎 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9128.text: A field worked by plowing. Formed from 田, depicting the bent movement of plowing.

shuowen:9129.text: To burn and sow. The Han Statutes says: 'In burned fields, remove the grass.' Formed from 田, with 翏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9130.text: A field cultivated for three years. The Changes says: 'Without first breaking ground, cultivate the third-year field.' Formed from 田, with 余 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9131.text: Soft or workable fields. Formed from 田, with 柔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9132.text: A remaining piece of field. Formed from 田, with 奇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9133.text: A remaining piece of field. The Odes says: 'Heaven is now repeatedly destroying.' Formed from 田, with 差 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9134.text: Six chi make a pace; one hundred paces make a 畮. Formed from 田, with 𣫭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9135.text: The Son of Heaven's domain extending five hundred li. Formed from 田 and abbreviated 包.

shuowen:9136.text: The Son of Heaven's domain extending one thousand li. When speaking of distance near or far, the term is 畿. Formed from 田, with abbreviated 幾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9137.text: Fifty mu of fields are called 畦. Formed from 田, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9138.text: Thirty mu of fields. Formed from 田, with 宛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9139.text: A field boundary. Formed from 田, with 半 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9140.text: A boundary. Formed from 田, with 介 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9141.text: A boundary. Alternatively, a field path: in Zhao and Wei, a 陌 is called 㽘. Formed from 田, with 亢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9142.text: A path between two field paths, six chi wide. Formed from 田, with 叕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9143.text: A field path between well-field plots. Formed from 田, with 㐱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9144.text: A place founded for Heaven, Earth, and the Five Emperors; sacrificial ground. Formed from 田, with 寺 indicating the sound. There are five 畤 in 右扶風. 好畤 and 鄜畤 were both sites of sacrifice in the Yellow Emperor's time; some say Duke Wen of Qin established them.

shuowen:9145.text: To survey and administer territory. Formed from 田, with 各 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9146.text: Fields facing or corresponding to one another. Formed from 田, with 尚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9147.text: A farmer. Formed from 田, with 夋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9148.text: People of the fields. Formed from 田, with 亡 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9149.text: To trample fields. Formed from 田, with 粦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9150.text: To stay or stop. Formed from 田, with 丣 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9151.text: To store or raise produce in fields. The Huainanzi says: '玄 and 田 make 畜.'

shuowen:9152.text: A place trodden by birds and beasts. The Odes says: 'Bare ground, a deer pasture.' Formed from 田, with 童 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9153.text: Not producing growth. Formed from 田, with 昜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9154.text: Adjacent fields. Formed from two 田. All characters in this group are formed from 畕.

shuowen:9155.text: A boundary. Formed from 畕; 三 marks its boundary lines.

shuowen:9156.text: The color of earth. Formed from 田 and 炗; 炗 also indicates the sound. 炗 is ancient-script 光. All characters in this group are formed from 黃.

shuowen:9157.text: Red-yellow. Alternatively, slighting people, as in 䵌姁. Formed from 黃, with 夾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9158.text: A yellow-black color. Formed from 黃, with 耑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9159.text: A blue-green and yellow color. Formed from 黃, with 有 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9160.text: A white-yellow color. Formed from 黃, with 占 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9161.text: Bright yellow. Formed from 黃, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9162.text: An adult man. Formed from 田 and 力, saying that men apply strength in the fields. All characters in this group are formed from 男.

shuowen:9163.text: A mother's brother is 𦥶; a wife's father is 外𦥶. Formed from 男, with 臼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9164.text: One who calls me maternal uncle, I call 甥. Formed from 男, with 生 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9165.text: Sinew. It depicts a person's sinews. Productive effort is called 力, able to ward off great disasters. All characters in this group are formed from 力.

shuowen:9166.text: The capacity to accomplish royal achievements. Formed from 力, with 熏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9167.text: To establish a state through labor. Formed from 力 and 工; 工 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:9168.text: To assist. Formed from 力, with 且 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9169.text: To assist. Formed from 力 and 非, with 慮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9170.text: To labor. Formed from 力, with 來 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9171.text: Careful. Formed from 力, with 吉 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: 'Carefully attend to the worthy ministers of Yin.'

shuowen:9172.text: To hasten or strive. Formed from 力, with 敄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9173.text: To press or compel. Formed from 力, with 强 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9174.text: To exert effort. The Book of Zhou says: 'Use your effort to assist our state and house.' Read like 萬. Formed from 力, with 萬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9175.text: To press or compel. Formed from 力, with 厥 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9176.text: Strong. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Men who are powerful opponents.' Formed from 力, with 京 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9177.text: Strong. Formed from 力, with 巠 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9178.text: To exert strength. Formed from 力, with 免 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9179.text: To encourage effort. Formed from 力, with 召 indicating the sound. Read like Shao, Shun's music 韶.

shuowen:9180.text: To encourage effort. The Book of Zhou says: 'Exert yourselves, gentlemen!' Formed from 力, with 冒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9181.text: To encourage effort. Formed from 力, with 雚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9182.text: To be capable of bearing. Formed from 力, with 朕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9183.text: To issue forth. Formed from 力 and 徹; 徹 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:9184.text: To combine strength. Formed from 力, with 翏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9185.text: Labor service being relaxed. Formed from 力, with 象 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9186.text: To act or move. Formed from 力, with 重 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9187.text: To push. Formed from 力, with 畾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9188.text: Weak. Formed from 力, with 少 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9189.text: Strenuous. Formed from 力 and abbreviated 熒. 熒 is fire burning a covering; one using strength is weary.

shuowen:9190.text: To strive or attend to a task. Formed from 力, with 豦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9191.text: Extremely intense. Formed from 力, with 𠑽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9192.text: Labor. The Odes says: 'None knows my toil.' Formed from 力, with 貰 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9193.text: To toil or weary. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Why weary the people?' Formed from 力, with 巢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9194.text: To toil or be weary. Formed from 力, with abbreviated 卷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9195.text: To labor. Formed from 力, with 𡏳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9196.text: Words augmenting one another. Formed from 力 and 口.

shuowen:9197.text: Vigorous. Formed from 力, with 敖 indicating the sound. Read like 豪.

shuowen:9198.text: Vital courage. Formed from 力, with 甬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9199.text: To push aside. Formed from 力, with 孛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9200.text: To seize by force. Formed from 力, with 㶾 indicating the sound.
